import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)

def cs(a, g):
    b = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64) * np.asarray(g, dtype=np.float64)[:, None]
    return b - b.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)

heads = {}
for l in range(12):
    g = W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"]
    a = W[f"L{l}.qkv.W"]
    out = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.out.W"], dtype=np.float64)
    for h in range(12):
        sl = slice(64*h, 64*(h+1))
        Q = cs(a[:, sl], g)
        K = cs(a[:, 768+64*h:768+64*(h+1)], g)
        V = cs(a[:, 1536+64*h:1536+64*(h+1)], g)
        O = out[sl]
        vgram = V.T @ V
        ovnorm = np.sqrt(max(np.sum(vgram * (O @ O.T)), 1e-30))
        qknorm = np.sqrt(max(np.sum((Q.T @ Q) * (K.T @ K)), 1e-30))
        heads[l,h] = dict(Q=Q, K=K, V=V, O=O, VG=vgram,
                          QG=Q.T@Q, KG=K.T@K, ovnorm=ovnorm,
                          qknorm=qknorm, copy=np.trace(O@V)/ovnorm)

pairs = []
for (lb,hb), b in heads.items():
    if lb == 0:
        continue
    for (la,ha), a in heads.items():
        if la >= lb or la > 4:
            continue
        T = a["O"] @ b["K"]
        S = a["V"].T @ b["Q"]
        norm = np.sqrt(max(np.sum(b["QG"] * (T.T @ a["VG"] @ T)), 1e-30))
        tr = np.sum(T*S)
        keyalign = tr / norm
        strength = norm * np.sqrt(768) / (a["ovnorm"] * b["qknorm"])

        Tq = a["O"] @ b["Q"]
        Sq = a["V"].T @ b["K"]
        qnorm = np.sqrt(max(np.sum(b["KG"] * (Tq.T @ a["VG"] @ Tq)), 1e-30))
        queryalign = np.sum(Tq*Sq) / qnorm
        pairs.append((lb,hb,la,ha,keyalign,strength,queryalign,b["copy"],tr))

print("BEST KEY-COMPOSITION MATCH FOR EACH DOWNSTREAM HEAD")
print("target source key_trace/F strength query_trace/F OVcopy raw_trace")
for lb in range(1,12):
    for hb in range(12):
        p = max((p for p in pairs if p[:2] == (lb,hb)), key=lambda p:p[4])
        print(f"{lb}.{hb:<2} {p[2]}.{p[3]:<2} " +
              " ".join(f"{x:8.3f}" for x in p[4:]))

print("\nTOP PAIRS WITH DOWNSTREAM OVcopy > 1.2")
eligible = [p for p in pairs if p[7] > 1.2]
for p in sorted(eligible, key=lambda p:p[4], reverse=True)[:45]:
    print(f"{p[0]}.{p[1]} <- {p[2]}.{p[3]} " +
          " ".join(f"{x:8.3f}" for x in p[4:]))

print("\nEARLY SOURCES: STRONGEST FIVE COPYING TARGETS")
for la in range(5):
    for ha in range(12):
        best = sorted((p for p in eligible if p[2:4] == (la,ha)),
                      key=lambda p:p[4], reverse=True)[:5]
        print(f"{la}.{ha:<2} " + " ".join(
            f"{p[0]}.{p[1]}:{p[4]:.2f}" for p in best))
